data.title: Privacy policy
data.text: What we collect, why, and the choices you have. Plain language, no surprises.

data.body:
_Last updated: 12 September 2026_

This policy explains what Woodex Interior ("we", "us") collects when you use this website or contact the studio, why we collect it, and the choices you have. It is written to be read, not skimmed — if anything is unclear, email us.

## Who we are

Woodex Interior is an interior design studio and joinery workshop at 12 Gulberg Boulevard, Lahore 54660, Pakistan. We are the controller of the personal data described here. Contact: [hello@woodexinterior.com](mailto:hello@woodexinterior.com) · +92 42 3500 0000.

## What we collect

- **Enquiry details** you send through the contact form, email or phone: name, email address, phone number, project type, budget range, location and anything you write in the message.
- **Newsletter sign-ups**: your email address and the date you subscribed.
- **Project records** if you become a client: site addresses, drawings, photographs, invoices and correspondence needed to deliver the work.
- **Technical data** collected automatically by our hosting provider: IP address, browser type, pages visited and timestamps, held in standard server logs.

We do not collect payment card details on this website and we do not buy data about you from third parties.

## Why we use it

- To reply to your enquiry, prepare a proposal and manage a project you commission (performance of a contract or steps before one).
- To send studio notes if you have subscribed (your consent, which you can withdraw at any time using the link in every email).
- To keep the website secure and understand which pages are useful (our legitimate interest in running the studio).
- To meet legal and accounting obligations, such as retaining invoices.

## Cookies and analytics

The site works without cookies. We use one item of browser session storage to remember that the home-page intro animation has already played; it is deleted when you close the tab. If we add analytics in future we will use a privacy-respecting, cookie-free tool and update this page.

## Who we share it with

Only the services we use to run the studio: our email and hosting providers, the form service that delivers enquiries to our inbox, and — for clients — the contractors, suppliers and consultants working on your project, limited to what they need. We never sell or rent personal data.

## How long we keep it

Enquiries that do not become projects are deleted after 24 months. Client project files are kept for 7 years after completion for warranty, tax and insurance reasons. Newsletter data is kept until you unsubscribe.

## Your rights

You can ask us at any time to access, correct, export or delete the personal data we hold about you, or to stop sending you marketing. Email [hello@woodexinterior.com](mailto:hello@woodexinterior.com) and we will respond within 30 days.

## Security

Enquiries are transmitted over HTTPS. Project files are stored on access-controlled cloud storage with two-factor authentication for all staff accounts.

## Changes

We will post any changes on this page and update the date at the top. Significant changes will also be mentioned in our newsletter.
